title: Actual adjunction and prescribed values for a transposed family

source.place: Steps 3--5: signed-line comparisons specified by their actual adjoint transposes; Stacks 06YY and 03EM.

statement: Given categories C,D, an adjunction F ⊣ G, index set I, families X:I→C and Y:I→D, and a parameter type A, record the actual adjunction, a family of value types V_i in the source hom universe and actual values v:A→Πi,V_i. Pointwise(d,a,i,b) is exactly HEq(d.adjunction.homEquiv(X_i,Y_i,b.hom),d.value(a,i)) for b:F(X_i)≅Y_i. Normalized(d,a,B) is the conjunction of those equations for all i. Pointwise equality determines an isomorphism uniquely by injectivity of the adjunction hom bijection and Iso.ext. No existence of an isomorphism is asserted by this data structure.

proof.text: Construct the record from the given adjunction and actual values. Define the pointwise equation and its dependent conjunction without changing either side. For pointwise uniqueness, compose the two heterogeneous equalities to get equality of adjoint images, apply injectivity of homEquiv, and then Iso.ext.

proof_origin: J2 actual-data interface repair: the existing signed-line normalization, pointwise existence witness and family assembly share one constructed transpose record. The generic uniqueness property is fully proved. No data are supplied by an unproved theorem. This avoids repeated kernel comparison of concrete single-functor and exact-restriction components; no proof is split off here.
